properties.property: Validator must have deposited exactly 32 ETH before entering activation queue
properties.formal_expression: FORALL v IN pending_validators: v.deposit_amount == 32_ETH AND v.deposit_processed == true

properties.property: Activation churn limit never exceeds MAX_PER_EPOCH_ACTIVATION_CHURN_LIMIT (8)
properties.formal_expression: ALWAYS activation_churn_limit <= 8

properties.property: After activation, validator can immediately attest and propose blocks
properties.formal_expression: AFTER activate_validator(v): v.can_attest == true AND v.can_propose == true

properties.property: Activations per epoch never exceed the computed churn limit
properties.formal_expression: FORALL epoch: count(activations_in_epoch) <= activation_churn_limit

properties.property: Validators exceeding epoch limit are deferred to next epoch without loss
properties.formal_expression: AFTER epoch_limit_reached: FORALL v IN deferred_validators: v.in_queue == true AND v.position_preserved == true

properties.property: Entry queue always bounded at 8 per epoch regardless of validator set size
properties.formal_expression: ALWAYS entry_rate_per_epoch <= 8

properties.property: Exit queue processing is not constrained by MAX_PER_EPOCH_ACTIVATION_CHURN_LIMIT
properties.formal_expression: exit_churn_limit != activation_churn_limit IMPLIES exit_churn_limit >= activation_churn_limit

properties.property: Mass exit scenario triggers consensus health evaluation
properties.formal_expression: WHEN exit_rate >> entry_rate: trigger_consensus_impact_evaluation() == true

properties.property: Post-EIP7514 validator growth is linear, not exponential
properties.formal_expression: POST_EIP7514: growth_rate == O(n) NOT O(exp(n))

properties.property: Maximum new validators per month is bounded at approximately 57,600
properties.formal_expression: AFTER one_month: new_validator_count <= 8 * 225 * 30 == 54000 (approx 57600 with 32 slots)

properties.property: Hard fork must activate before churn cap takes effect
properties.formal_expression: BEFORE apply_max_churn_cap(): fork_activated == false IMPLIES churn_unbounded == true

properties.property: EVM must be executing contract bytecode before nested call can occur
properties.formal_expression: BEFORE nested_call(): evm_state == EXECUTING AND bytecode_loaded == true

properties.property: Call depth never exceeds EVM_RECURSION_LIMIT (12288)
properties.formal_expression: ALWAYS call_depth < 12288

properties.property: Call depth increments by exactly 1 for each nested call
properties.formal_expression: AFTER nested_call(): call_depth == call_depth_before + 1

properties.property: Exceeding recursion limit causes call to fail with return value 0
properties.formal_expression: AFTER check_recursion_limit() WHERE depth >= 12288: call_return_value == 0 AND call_success == false

properties.property: CALL, DELEGATECALL, STATICCALL, and CREATE all subject to same recursion limit
properties.formal_expression: FORALL op IN [CALL, DELEGATECALL, STATICCALL, CREATE]: op.recursion_limit == 12288

properties.property: Package must be initialized before version can be read
properties.formal_expression: BEFORE read_version(): package_initialized == true

properties.property: Version read returns consistent string value
properties.formal_expression: AFTER read_version(): result == '2.19.0' AND typeof(result) == string

properties.property: Node must be running with loaded fork configurations before accepting eth_config requests
properties.formal_expression: BEFORE receive_eth_config_request(): node_state == RUNNING AND fork_config_loaded == true

properties.property: All eth_config requests must pass validation before processing
properties.formal_expression: FORALL request: process_eth_config(request) IMPLIES validate_request(request) == VALID

properties.property: Rate limit exceeded results in request rejection, not processing
properties.formal_expression: AFTER check_rate_limit() WHERE exceeded == true: request_processed == false

properties.property: Response includes current, next, and last fork configurations
properties.formal_expression: AFTER build_response(): response.has('current') AND response.has('next') AND response.has('last')

properties.property: Current fork configuration is never null when node is operational
properties.formal_expression: ALWAYS (node_operational == true IMPLIES current_config != null)

properties.property: Fork transition triggers cache purge for configuration data
properties.formal_expression: AFTER cross_fork_boundary(): config_caches_valid == false

properties.property: Next and last configurations may be null but must be explicitly represented
properties.formal_expression: AFTER read_config(): (next_config == null OR next_config.valid) AND (last_config == null OR last_config.valid)

properties.property: Validator must have own node configuration before comparing with reference
properties.formal_expression: BEFORE compare_configs(): own_config_retrieved == true

properties.property: Configuration mismatch triggers operator alert
properties.formal_expression: AFTER compare_configs() WHERE mismatch == true: operator_alert_sent == true

properties.property: Configuration comparison is deterministic for same input configurations
properties.formal_expression: FORALL c1, c2: compare(c1, c2) == compare(c1, c2)

properties.property: Rate limiting must be enabled before DDoS mitigation is effective
properties.formal_expression: BEFORE ddos_mitigation_effective(): rate_limiting_enabled == true

properties.property: Rate limiting prevents resource exhaustion from repeated requests
properties.formal_expression: AFTER apply_rate_limit(): resource_exhausted == false

properties.property: Access restriction limits eth_config to trusted interfaces only
properties.formal_expression: AFTER restrict_access(): FORALL req FROM untrusted_interface: req.rejected == true

properties.property: Cross-checking multiple sources detects dishonest configuration reporting
properties.formal_expression: AFTER cross_check() WHERE node_dishonest == true: dishonesty_detected == true

properties.property: Configuration data leakage is informational only, not exploitable for consensus attacks
properties.formal_expression: FORALL leaked_config: exploit_for_consensus_attack(leaked_config) == false
